description: Free. Verify a manifest JSON you were handed: JCS manifest_id recomputation + ML-DSA-65 signature (alg anchored; key 1952 B, signature 3309 B; nothing inferred from sizes) + lifetime. The verification key is (a) pubkey_b64url if you supply it (caller-trusted, fully offline), else (b) the agent's CURRENT key as the registry/node reports it, used only if it equals the manifest's embedded key (registry-assisted). The embedded key alone is never trusted. Returns three SEPARATE verdicts { signature_ok, passport_valid, agent_active } and ok = all three true with verdict "current"/"not_current" (with a caller-supplied key the registry is not consulted: verdict is "signature_only", ok is null when the signature verifies (never true) and false when it does not, passport_valid and agent_active are null — say so to the user). Plus { checks[], trust }.

pubkey_b64url.description: Optional: the agent's ML-DSA-65 public key (base64url, 1952 bytes) from a source YOU trust.
